name.en: English Stock Promotional & Excess AI Clichés

mechanism.en: RLHF preference tuning strongly amplifies a narrow set of dramatic promotional phrases (`delve into`, `rich tapestry of`, `game-changer`, `paradigm shift`, `unlock the full potential`).
mechanism.zh: RLHF 偏好对齐显著放大了一批高频夸饰短语（如 `delve into`、`rich tapestry of`、`game-changer`、`paradigm shift`）。

falsePositiveGuards: Multi-word collocations prevent false hits on literal nouns/tools like `wool tapestry` or the `Delve` Go debugger.

exemplar.bad: Batch indexing is a game-changer that unlocks the full potential of our 40-million-row log archive.
exemplar.trap: This isn't indexing. It's instant recall across 40 million rows.
exemplar.good: Batch indexing cuts 40-million-row log queries from 19 seconds to 1.4 seconds.

name.zh: 中文公文黑话与空泛套词

mechanism.en: Chinese business-trained models default to abstract management jargon (`赋能`, `抓手`, `组合拳`, `闭环`, `底层逻辑`, `颗粒度`) that hides actors, actions, and measurable deltas.
mechanism.zh: 中文职场语料微调使模型习惯用“赋能、抓手、组合拳、闭环、底层逻辑、颗粒度”等抽象名词替代具体动作与结果。

falsePositiveGuards: Negative lookahead excludes `抓手机`; hardware terms can be allow-listed via `.dislop.json`.

exemplar.bad: 值得注意的是，本次改造以工单分级为重要抓手，全面赋能一线客服团队形成服务闭环，将首响时间压缩至 45 秒内。
exemplar.trap: 这不是一次工单改造，而是客服体验的底气：首响压缩至 45 秒内。
exemplar.good: 本次改造按问题紧急度拆分工单队列，一线客服首次响应时间压缩至 45 秒内。

name.zh: 低事实段落弱套词共现簇

mechanism.en: Multiple mild corporate verbs and modifiers (`leverage`, `streamline`, `robust`, `有效推动`, `持续优化`, `显著提升`) stack in one low-evidence paragraph without concrete numbers or mechanisms.
mechanism.zh: 单个温和修饰词无害，但在缺乏实测事实的同一段落里密集堆叠多个弱套词（如“有效推动/持续优化/显著提升”），形成典型 AI 报告空话。

falsePositiveGuards: High concrete-evidence density (numbers, timestamps, code spans) dampens false triggers; single isolated words never fire.

exemplar.bad: 本次客服系统升级旨在有效推动跨部门协同效率，持续优化客户交互体验，并进一步助力业务团队实现精细化运营，最终显著提升整体服务质量。
exemplar.trap: 客服系统升级不是功能叠加，而是服务体验的全面跃升。
exemplar.good: 本次客服系统按工单紧急度拆成 3 级队列，上线首周平均首响时间从 110 秒降到 42 秒。

name.zh: 中文 AI 翻译腔与空洞连接词簇

mechanism.en: Individual mild connectors (`换句话说`, `至关重要`, `在……的背景下`, `扮演着重要角色`) can appear in human prose, but LLMs stack 2+ of them inside a single short paragraph, creating unmistakable translated AI prose.
mechanism.zh: 单个温和连接词或书面套语（如“至关重要”“在……的背景下”“扮演着重要角色”“不可否认的是”）偶发无害，但大模型常在同段内连用 2 处及以上，形成典型 AI 翻译腔。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires >= 2 distinct calque/filler signals inside the same paragraph (never triggers on a single isolated phrase).
Skips headings, lists, code blocks, and quoted material.

exemplar.bad: 在数字化转型的背景下，不可否认的是，缓存优化在系统稳定性中扮演着至关重要的角色，不仅如此，它还为业务增长提供了有力支撑。
exemplar.trap: 数字化转型来了。缓存很重要。稳定是底气。
exemplar.good: 缓存命中率从 71% 提到 94% 后，高峰期数据库读负载降了一半。

name.zh: 英文超额 AI 词汇簇

mechanism.en: Based on empirical excess-word studies (Kobak et al. arXiv:2406.07016; Liang et al. arXiv:2404.01268), single words like `robust` or `comprehensive` occur normally in technical writing, whereas clustering 3+ distinct excess words/collocations inside one paragraph signals unedited LLM prose.
mechanism.zh: 基于文献超额词统计（Kobak et al., 2024; Liang et al., 2024），单个 `robust` 或 `comprehensive` 在技术文档里常见，但单段内聚集 3 个及以上不同超额词/搭配即为高置信 AI 腔信号。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires >= 3 distinct excess signals inside a single prose paragraph.
Single occurrences of `robust`, `comprehensive`, or `leverage` in engineering specs stay completely silent.

exemplar.bad: This comprehensive platform seamlessly leverages a robust, holistic architecture to foster pivotal collaboration and underscore our meticulous design.
exemplar.trap: This platform isn't just robust — it's built for modern teams.
exemplar.good: The platform syncs edits across 12 regional clusters in under 150 ms using a single Postgres primary.

name.zh: 中文研发与产品自嗨黑话簇

mechanism.en: Dense stacking of 3+ Chinese AI/engineering buzzwords (`全闭环`, `收口`, `强兜底`, `硬熔断`, `拉齐`, `零误差`, `体系化`) inside a single paragraph hides actual retry/exit behavior.
mechanism.zh: 单段堆砌 3 处及以上中文研发/产品自嗨黑话（全闭环、收口、强兜底、硬熔断、拉齐、零误差、……化），用强硬姿态词替代具体的重试次数、状态码与限流阈值。

falsePositiveGuards: Requires >= 3 distinct buzzwords in the same paragraph or table cell so single standard architecture terms do not fire.

exemplar.bad: 本次发布建立全闭环校验机制，通过硬熔断完成总收口并形成强兜底，确保链路零误差交付。
exemplar.trap: 这不只是发布脚本，而是零缺陷交付的工程铁律。
exemplar.good: 发布脚本在合入前运行单测与类型检查；任一失败直接退出非零状态码，并保留前一次构建产物用于回滚。
